summary_1line: Bhishma explains that a righteous king, by just rule and compassion, gains the merits of all four life stages and shares responsibility for his subjects’ virtue or sin.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, instructs Yudhishthira seated beside him about the sacred duties of kingship.
A just king stands in court distributing gifts to sages and protecting distressed subjects who seek refuge.
